lines.text: There's a jellyfish that can live forever.
When it grows old, it simply turns young again <break time="0.7s"/> and starts over.
Its name is dohrnii. Ours is Dorni.
AI has eaten software. But the world of atoms is still waiting.
Now we have the tools to make brands last forever.
More functional. Healthier. Longer human lives.
D-to-C health brands, enhanced by Dorni OS.
Acquiring the brands that will help billions live longer, healthier lives.

bgm.query: deep ambient, underwater synths building to a hopeful swell
bgm.blob: AI ate software; now Dorni brings those tools to the world of atoms, building D2C health brands that last forever, like the immortal jellyfish.
bgm.arc: Future Pacing (imagine → name → shift → mechanism → outcome → brand)
